Normfunctie.title: Reference job
Normfunctie.description: A job function in your catalogue: a function from the HR21 reference library (VNG) or one of your own, mapped to a Cao Gemeenten schaal and optionally to a salary band. Retire a function instead of deleting it, so contracts that point at it keep their meaning.

functiecode.title: Job code
functiecode.description: The stable HR21 normfunctie code (e.g. 'HR21-001'). The natural key a maintainer identifies this normfunctie by.

naam.title: Name
naam.description: The reference job's name, for example 'Senior Beleidsmedewerker'.

functiegroep.title: Job family
functiegroep.description: The HR21 hoofdproces this normfunctie belongs to (e.g. 'Beleid', 'Beheer', 'Management').

caoSchaal.title: Collective agreement scale
caoSchaal.description: The collective agreement scale ('1' to '19') this reference job maps to.
caoSchaal.x-notes: The Cao Gemeenten schaal (numeric key '1'-'19', the same key space cao-gemeenten.payScales uses) this normfunctie maps to. Read against EmploymentContract.caoSchaal by nl-hr21-schaal-consistentie only when caoSchaalVerified is true.

caoSchaalVerified.title: Collective agreement scale verified
caoSchaalVerified.description: The mapping has been checked against an official source. Until then it is advisory and is not enforced.
caoSchaalVerified.x-notes: Whether this normfunctie's caoSchaal mapping is confirmed against a primary HR21/VNG source. When false the mapping is advisory (placeholder) and nl-hr21-schaal-consistentie stays vacuous for any contract assigned to it -- the cao-library payScalesVerified precedent, applied to a classification mapping instead of a rate.

caoSchaalSource.title: Collective agreement scale source
caoSchaalSource.description: Which source confirms this mapping, or why it was marked verified.
caoSchaalSource.x-notes: Human-readable note naming the authority to confirm this mapping against (e.g. 'HR21/VNG functieboek -- not yet independently confirmed'), or explaining why a specific row was flipped to verified for illustrative/demonstration purposes only.

bron.title: Source
bron.description: Where the function comes from: the HR21 reference library or your own catalogue.
bron.x-notes: people-job-framework-maintenance D2: hr21 for rows taken over from the VNG HR21 library, eigen for employer functions.

functiefamilie.title: Function family
functiefamilie.description: The family the function belongs to, for example Informatie or Beleid.
functiefamilie.x-notes: people-job-framework-maintenance D2: free text grouping, beside the HR21 functiegroep.

salaryBandId.title: Salary band
salaryBandId.description: The salary band this function is graded in, if any.
salaryBandId.x-notes: people-job-framework-maintenance D2: optional link to the SalaryBand the comp-cycles machinery uses.

status.title: Status
status.description: Retire a function instead of deleting it: contracts that point at it keep their meaning, and the rules audit asks you to give those contracts a current function.
status.x-notes: people-job-framework-maintenance D1/D4: retire, never delete; nl-hr21-vervallen-functie flags a live contract on a vervallen function.
